QuestInfo.0: It seems like Jiyur is no longer suffering from the cold after eating the medicine you helped out with. But maybe Jiyur will catch a cold again?
QuestInfo.1: Jiyur needs enough #r#t4000934##k and #r#t4000935##k to hand out to the poor people of town. Go get the cold weather gear for the kindhearted Jiyur.
QuestInfo.2: You got the Scarf and Earmuff for the people of town so that they won't catch a cold again. It's going to be a warm night.
